matching: Maximum-cardinality one-to-one matching within joint normalized distance 1, then minimum total distance.
threshold: Fraction of maximum absolute intensity after median centring; dominant sign.
denominator: Assigned coordinates in the common spectrum range after whole-axis referencing; coordinates are not folded.

apo_author_calibration.fit: Even deposited sequence indices; author spectrum only.

author_only_at_10_percent.method: Retest at 7.5% and 5% without changing assignments or tolerances. For diagnosis only, inspect same-sign voxels and independent candidates down to 2.5% or five noise standard deviations, whichever is higher. Inspect author peak apex profiles in every dimension and check the positions against separately processed spectra from the same acquisition.

gly100_his194_nitrogen_controls.method: Process the full BMRB 27493 acquisition with the same direct dimension, indirect phase and baseline across controls. The SP controls use off 0.5, end 1, power 2 and first point scale 0.5; the EM control uses 3 Hz and first point scale 0.5. The LP controls extend the nitrogen FID before applying that SP window. Listed apexes are the major local features (at least 25% of each spectrum maximum) on the sampled spectral grid after whole-axis referencing.
